shloka_text: एतदाख्याय रामाय महर्षिः कुम्भसम्भवः । अस्यामेवापरं वाक्यं कथायामुपचक्रमे ।। 7.80.1 ।।
transliteration: etadākhyāya rāmāya maharṣiḥ kumbhasambhavaḥ | asyāmevāparaṃ vākyaṃ kathāyāmupacakrame || 7.80.1 ||
translation: एतत् this, आख्याय having narrated, रामाय to Rama, महर्षिः the great sage, कुम्भसम्भवः Agastya, अस्याम् in this, एव indeed, अपरम् another, वाक्यम् statement, कथायाम् in the story, उपचक्रमे began.
explanation: Having narrated this to Rama, the great sage Agastya then began another part of the same story.
comments: At Bhrigu's hermitage King Danda lusts for the sage's daughter Araja -- though she bids him seek her lawfully from her father, his own preceptor, the maddened king forces her and flees to his city -- and the terrified Araja waits weeping for her father's return.

shloka_text: ततः स दण्डः काकुत्स्थ बहुवर्षगणायुतम् । अकरोत्तत्र दान्तात्मा राज्यं निहतकण्टकम् ।। 7.80.2 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa daṇḍaḥ kākutstha bahuvarṣagaṇāyutam | akarottatra dāntātmā rājyaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam || 7.80.2 ||
translation: ततः then, सः he, दण्डः Danda, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, बहुवर्षगणायुतम् for many thousands of years, अकरोत् ruled, तत्र there, दान्तात्मा with a controlled self, राज्यम् the kingdom, निहतकण्टकम् free from enemies.
explanation: O Kakutstha, then King Danda, with a controlled mind, ruled his kingdom there, free from enemies, for many thousands of years.

shloka_text: अथ काले तु कस्मिंश्चिद्राजा भार्गवमाश्रमम् । रमणीयमुपाक्रामच्चैत्रे मासि मनोरमे ।। 7.80.3 ।।
transliteration: atha kāle tu kasmiṃścidrājā bhārgavamāśramam | ramaṇīyamupākrāmaccaitre māsi manorame || 7.80.3 ||
translation: अथ then, काले at a time, तु indeed, कस्मिंश्चित् some, राजा the king, भार्गवम् of Bhrigu, आश्रमम् the hermitage, रमणीयम् delightful, उपाक्रामत् approached, चैत्रे in Chaitra, मासि in the month, मनोरमे charming.
explanation: Then, at some point, the king approached the delightful hermitage of Bhrigu in the charming month of Chaitra.

shloka_text: तत्र भार्गवकन्यां स रूपेणाप्रतिमां भुवि । विचरन्तीं वनोद्देशे दण्डो ऽपश्यदनुत्तमाम् ।। 7.80.4 ।।
transliteration: tatra bhārgavakanyāṃ sa rūpeṇāpratimāṃ bhuvi | vicarantīṃ vanoddeśe daṇḍo 'paśyadanuttamām || 7.80.4 ||
translation: तत्र there, भार्गवकन्याम् the daughter of Bhrigu, सः he, रूपेण in beauty, अप्रतिमाम् unequalled, भुवि on earth, विचरन्तीम् wandering, वनोद्देशे in the forest region, दण्डः Danda, अपश्यत् saw, अनुत्तमाम् unsurpassed.
explanation: There, King Danda saw the unsurpassed daughter of Bhrigu, unequalled in beauty on earth, wandering in the forest region.

shloka_text: स दृष्ट्वा तां सुदुर्मेधा अनङ्गशरपीडितः । अभिगम्य सुसंविग्नां कन्यां वचनमब्रवीत् ।। 7.80.5 ।।
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā tāṃ sudurmedhā anaṅgaśarapīḍitaḥ | abhigamya susaṃvignāṃ kanyāṃ vacanamabravīt || 7.80.5 ||
translation: सः he, दृष्ट्वा having seen, ताम् her, सुदुर्मेधाः very foolish, अनङ्गशरपीडितः afflicted by the arrows of Kama, अभिगम्य having approached, सुसंविग्नाम् very agitated, कन्याम् the maiden, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having seen her, the very foolish king, afflicted by the arrows of Kama, approached the very agitated maiden and spoke words to her.

shloka_text: कुतस्त्वमसि सुश्रोणि कस्य वा ऽसि सुता शुभे । पीडितो ऽहमनङ्गेन गच्छामि त्वां शुभानने ।। 7.80.6 ।।
transliteration: kutastvamasi suśroṇi kasya vā 'si sutā śubhe | pīḍito 'hamanaṅgena gacchāmi tvāṃ śubhānane || 7.80.6 ||
translation: कुतः whence, त्वम् you, असि are, सुश्रोणि O beautiful-hipped one, कस्य whose, वा or, असि are, सुता daughter, शुभे O auspicious one, पीडितः afflicted, अहम् I, अनङ्गेन by Ananga, गच्छामि I approach, त्वाम् you, शुभानने O beautiful-faced one.
explanation: O beautiful-hipped one, from where are you, or whose daughter are you, O auspicious one; I am tormented by Cupid, and so I approach you, O beautiful-faced one.

shloka_text: तस्य त्वेवं ब्रुवाणस्य मोहोन्मत्तस्य कामिनः । भार्गवी प्रत्युवाचेदं वचः सानुनयं नृपम् ।। 7.80.7 ।।
transliteration: tasya tvevaṃ bruvāṇasya mohonmattasya kāminaḥ | bhārgavī pratyuvācedaṃ vacaḥ sānunayaṃ nṛpam || 7.80.7 ||
translation: तस्य to him, तु indeed, एवम् thus, ब्रुवाणस्य speaking, मोहोन्मत्तस्य maddened by delusion, कामिनः lustful, भार्गवी the daughter of Bhrigu, प्रत्युवाच replied, इदम् this, वचः word, सानुनयम् with humility, नृपम् to the king.
explanation: To that lustful king, who was speaking thus, maddened by infatuation, the daughter of Bhrigu replied with these humble words.

shloka_text: भार्गवस्य सुतां विद्धि देवस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः । अरजां नाम राजेन्द्र ज्येष्ठामाश्रमवासिनीम् ।। 7.80.8 ।।
transliteration: bhārgavasya sutāṃ viddhi devasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ | arajāṃ nāma rājendra jyeṣṭhāmāśramavāsinīm || 7.80.8 ||
translation: भार्गवस्य of Bhrigu, सुताम् daughter, विद्धि know, देवस्य of the divine one, अक्लिष्टकर्मणः of unwearied deeds, अरजाम् Araja, नाम named, राजेन्द्र O king of kings, ज्येष्ठाम् the eldest, आश्रमवासिनीम् dwelling in the hermitage.
explanation: O king of kings, know me to be Araja by name, the eldest daughter of the divine sage Bhrigu, whose deeds are pure, and who dwells in the hermitage.

shloka_text: मा मां स्पृश बलाद्राजन्कन्या पितृवशा ह्यहम् । गुरुः पिता मे राजेन्द्र त्वं च शिष्यो महात्मनः । व्यसनं सुमहत्क्रुद्धः स ते दद्यान्महातपाः ।। 7.80.9 ।।
transliteration: mā māṃ spṛśa balādrājankanyā pitṛvaśā hyaham | guruḥ pitā me rājendra tvaṃ ca śiṣyo mahātmanaḥ | vyasanaṃ sumahatkruddhaḥ sa te dadyānmahātapāḥ || 7.80.9 ||
translation: मा do not, माम् me, स्पृश touch, बलात् by force, राजन् O king, कन्या a maiden, पितृवशा dependent on her father, हि indeed, अहम् I, गुरुः teacher, पिता father, मे my, राजेन्द्र O king of kings, त्वम् you, च and, शिष्यः disciple, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, व्यसनम् calamity, सुमहत् very great, क्रुद्धः enraged, सः he, ते to you, दद्यात् would give, महातपाः of great penance.
explanation: O king, do not touch me by force, for I am a maiden dependent on my father; O king of kings, my father is your preceptor, and you are the disciple of that great-souled one, and if enraged, that sage of great penance would inflict a very great calamity upon you.

shloka_text: यदि वान्यन्मया कार्यं धर्मदृष्टेन सत्पथा । वरयस्व नरश्रेष्ठ पितरं मे महाद्युतिम् ।। 7.80.10 ।।
transliteration: yadi vānyanmayā kāryaṃ dharmadṛṣṭena satpathā | varayasva naraśreṣṭha pitaraṃ me mahādyutim || 7.80.10 ||
translation: यदि if, वा or, अन्यत् anything else, मया by me, कार्यम् to be done, धर्मदृष्टेन according to dharma, सत्पथा by the righteous path, वरयस्व ask for, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, पितरम् father, मे my, महाद्युतिम् highly effulgent.
explanation: O best among men, if anything else is to be done by me according to the righteous path of dharma, then ask for me from my glorious father.

shloka_text: अन्यथा तु फलं तुभ्यं भवेद्घोराभिसंहितम् । क्रोधेन हि पिता मे ऽसौ त्रैलोक्यमपि निर्दहेत् ।। 7.80.11 ।।
transliteration: anyathā tu phalaṃ tubhyaṃ bhavedghorābhisaṃhitam | krodhena hi pitā me 'sau trailokyamapi nirdahet || 7.80.11 ||
translation: अन्यथा otherwise, तु indeed, फलम् consequence, तुभ्यम् for you, भवेत् would be, घोराभिसंहितम् terrible, क्रोधेन by anger, हि indeed, पिता father, मे my, असौ he, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, अपि even, निर्दहेत् would burn completely.
explanation: Otherwise, the consequence for you would be terrible, for my father, in his anger, could indeed burn down even the three worlds.

shloka_text: दास्यते चानवद्याङ्ग तव मा याचितः पिता ।। 7.80.12 ।।
transliteration: dāsyate cānavadyāṅga tava mā yācitaḥ pitā || 7.80.12 ||
translation: दास्यते will give, च and, अनवद्याङ्ग O one with faultless limbs, तव to you, मा me, याचितः when requested, पिता father.
explanation: And O one with faultless limbs, my father will give me to you when he is requested.

shloka_text: एवं ब्रुवाणामरजां दण्डः कामवशं गतः । प्रत्युवाच मदोन्मत्तः शिरस्याधाय चाञ्जलिम् ।। 7.80.13 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ bruvāṇāmarajāṃ daṇḍaḥ kāmavaśaṃ gataḥ | pratyuvāca madonmattaḥ śirasyādhāya cāñjalim || 7.80.13 ||
translation: एवम् thus, ब्रुवाणाम् to the speaking, अरजाम् to Araja, दण्डः Danda, कामवशम् under the sway of desire, गतः having gone, प्रत्युवाच replied, मदोन्मत्तः intoxicated with passion, शिरसि on the head, आधाय having placed, च and, अञ्जलिम् folded hands.
explanation: Having thus gone under the sway of desire, Danda, intoxicated with passion, replied to Araja, placing his folded hands on his head.

shloka_text: प्रसादं कुरु सुश्रोणि न कालं क्षेप्तुमर्हसि । त्वत्कृते हि मम प्राणा विदीर्यन्ते वरानने ।। 7.80.14 ।।
transliteration: prasādaṃ kuru suśroṇi na kālaṃ kṣeptumarhasi | tvatkṛte hi mama prāṇā vidīryante varānane || 7.80.14 ||
translation: प्रसादम् favor, कुरु do, सुश्रोणि O one with beautiful hips, न not, कालम् time, क्षेप्तुम् to waste, अर्हसि you ought, त्वत्कृते for your sake, हि indeed, मम my, प्राणाः life breaths, विदीर्यन्ते are being torn apart, वरानने O one with a beautiful face.
explanation: O one with beautiful hips and a beautiful face, please grant me your favor; you should not waste time, for indeed, my life breaths are being torn apart for your sake.

shloka_text: त्वां प्राप्य मे वधो वा स्याच्छापो वा यदि दारुणः । भक्तं भजस्व मां भीरु भजमानं सुविह्वलम् ।। 7.80.15 ।।
transliteration: tvāṃ prāpya me vadho vā syācchāpo vā yadi dāruṇaḥ | bhaktaṃ bhajasva māṃ bhīru bhajamānaṃ suvihvalam || 7.80.15 ||
translation: त्वाम् you, प्राप्य having obtained, मे my, वधः death, वा or, स्यात् may be, शापः curse, वा or, यदि if, दारुणः terrible, भक्तम् devoted, भजस्व accept, माम् me, भीरु O timid one, भजमानम् serving, सुविह्वलम् greatly agitated.
explanation: O timid one, even if I obtain you and face death or a terrible curse, please accept me, your devoted servant who is greatly agitated.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा तु तां कन्यां दोर्भ्यां गृह्य बलाद्बली । विस्फुरन्तीं यथाकामं मैथुनायोपचक्रमे ।। 7.80.16 ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu tāṃ kanyāṃ dorbhyāṃ gṛhya balādbalī | visphurantīṃ yathākāmaṃ maithunāyopacakrame || 7.80.16 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, तु indeed, ताम् her, कन्याम् maiden, दोर्भ्याम् with two arms, गृह्य having seized, बलात् by force, बली the strong one, विस्फुरन्तीम् struggling, यथाकामम् as he desired, मैथुनाय for sexual intercourse, उपचक्रमे he began.
explanation: Having spoken thus, the powerful Daṇḍa seized the struggling maiden with his arms by force and proceeded to have sexual intercourse with her as he desired.

shloka_text: एतमर्थं महाघोरं दण्डः कृत्वा सुदारुणम् । नगरं प्रययावाशु मधुमन्तमनुत्तमम् ।। 7.80.17 ।।
transliteration: etamarthaṃ mahāghoraṃ daṇḍaḥ kṛtvā sudāruṇam | nagaraṃ prayayāvāśu madhumantamanuttamam || 7.80.17 ||
translation: एतम् this, अर्थम् deed, महाघोरम् very terrible, दण्डः Daṇḍa, कृत्वा having committed, सुदारुणम् very cruel, नगरम् to the city, प्रययाव he went, आशु quickly, मधुमन्तम् Madhumanta, अनुत्तमम् unequalled.
explanation: Having committed this extremely dreadful and very cruel act, Daṇḍa quickly departed to his unequalled city of Madhumanta.

shloka_text: अरजा ऽपि रुदन्ती सा आश्रमस्याविदूरतः । प्रतीक्षन्ति सुसंत्रस्ता पितरं देवसन्निभम् ।। 7.80.18 ।।
transliteration: arajā 'pi rudantī sā āśramasyāvidūrataḥ | pratīkṣanti susaṃtrastā pitaraṃ devasannibham || 7.80.18 ||
translation: अरजा Arajā, अपि also, रुदन्ती weeping, सा she, आश्रमस्य of the hermitage, अविदूरतः not far from, प्रतीक्षन्ति she waited for, सुसंत्रस्ता greatly terrified, पितरम् father, देवसन्निभम् god-like.
explanation: Arajā, greatly terrified and weeping, waited for her god-like father not far from the hermitage. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 80 ।। Thus ends the eightieth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
